stories.title: Indiana Hoosiers climbed 19 places to finish No. 1
stories.copy: Among the 13 teams ranked in both the AP preseason and final polls, Indiana Hoosiers made the largest rise, moving from No. 20 to No. 1. Texas Longhorns had the largest drop among those same teams, from No. 1 to No. 12. These are AP poll positions, not a ranking calculated from game statistics.

stories.title: D. Mestemaker (UNT) led the FBS in passing yards
stories.copy: With at least 100 pass attempts, D. Mestemaker of North Texas Mean Green led these prepared season totals with 4,379 yards, 34 passing touchdowns, and a 68.9% completion rate across 14 games. The 100-attempt floor keeps the comparison focused on quarterbacks with a meaningful workload.

stories.title: C. Cook (JVST) topped the rushing chart
stories.copy: C. Cook of Jacksonville State Gamecocks led the 100-attempt rushing cohort with 1,659 yards on 295 carries, 5.62 yards per carry, and 16 rushing touchdowns. The average is recomputed from season yards divided by season attempts.

stories.title: D. Scudero (SJSU) led in receiving yards
stories.copy: With at least 40 receptions, D. Scudero of San José State Spartans led the receiving cohort with 1,291 yards on 88 catches, averaging 14.67 yards per reception, with 10 receiving touchdowns. That was 696 yards ahead of J. Tibbs, the next player in the same qualifying group.

stories.title: N. Tucker (WMU) paced the sack leaders
stories.copy: Among defenders appearing in at least eight games, N. Tucker of Western Michigan Broncos recorded 14.5 sacks. The same games-played threshold applies to this chart. O. Long of Colorado State Rams led the qualifying tackle total with 151 tackles.

stories.title: North Texas Mean Green averaged 45.1 points per game
stories.copy: North Texas Mean Green led teams with at least eight team-game rows, averaging 45.07 points across 14 games with a reported score. Their recorded season line was 12-2. Points per game is total nonmissing points divided by scored team-game rows; FBS games against FCS opponents remain in the sample.

stories.title: North Texas Mean Green averaged 512.4 yards per game
stories.copy: North Texas Mean Green led the teams with at least eight games in average total offense, at 512.4 yards per game across 14 team-game rows. The bars separate reported net passing yards and rushing yards per game; they are source box-score fields and may not sum exactly to total yards.

stories.title: Indiana Hoosiers converted 56.5% of third downs
stories.copy: Among teams with at least 80 recorded third-down attempts and eight or more games, Indiana Hoosiers converted 113 of 200 chances (56.5%). The rate uses summed conversions divided by summed attempts, not an average of game percentages.

stories.title: 151 FBS-involving games finished within three points
stories.copy: Of 934 FBS-involving games with both final scores present, 151 ended with a margin of three points or fewer. The narrowest result in the source schedule was Clemson Tigers 45, Duke Blue Devils 46 in Week 10. This uses the schedule’s home/away score labels, including neutral-site games.

stories.title: Week 2 produced the highest regular-season scoring average
stories.copy: Week 2 averaged 31.41 points per team-game, compared with 16.50 in Week 16. This timeline includes schedule season-type 2 only. ESPN schedule week numbers restart at 1 for postseason games, so bowl and playoff games are not merged into regular-season Week 1. Rates use nonmissing team score rows in each week.

stories.title: The Top 25 changed by 43 entries and 43 exits across available weekly polls
stories.copy: Across the 16 transitions after the first captured snapshot, teams entered the AP Top 25 43 times and dropped out 43 times. These are team-poll transitions, so a program may enter or leave more than once. A departure is shown as unranked in that poll period; the trend data never assigns an invented No. 26.

rate_definitions.points_per_game: sum of nonmissing team points / team-game rows with nonmissing points
rate_definitions.third_down_pct: sum of third-down conversions / sum of third-down attempts × 100
rate_definitions.ranking_movement: previous rank minus current rank; positive means moved up
rate_definitions.AP_weeks_ranked: count of regular-season polls in which a team appears in the Top 25
